title: David defeats the Philistines at Baal-perazim
description: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up to search for him and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim. David sought counsel from God and received a promise of victory. At Baal-perazim he struck down the enemy, saying that God had broken through like bursting waters. The Philistines left their idols behind, and David ordered them to be burned.
